And here's a small tip from me: If you have a gaming peripheral that supports repeating macros, I highly recommend having a macro that spams left click at least roughly every 60 milliseconds and set it to run while you have a button held down. Now when you're in game and you have to mine something, hold your macro while you have something you want to mine/chop/attack and then you should do those actions much faster! Note that if you're playing singleplayer Don't Starve and you're trying to chop down trees, there will be tree-leave falling particles that will block your mouse clicks that spawn directly from the middle of the tree, so try to keep your mouse as close to the top of the tree as you can without the mouse moving out of range for the tree swaying from the hit animations.
